protocol.target: Above 10% full-calendar-year return after costs; show every year and market, including failures
protocol.policy: Four equal initial sleeves; long-only, no leverage; above 200-session moving average; 60-session volatility sizing capped at 100% of each sleeve. Timestral additionally requires five-session median price change above 0.3%. Signals execute next open; weight changes pay turnover costs; dividends to prior holders; liquidate final close.
protocol.promotion: No automatic promotion. Display target achievement, excess return versus both baselines, drawdown, exposure and cost sensitivity for all four groups.
protocol.news: No complete archived company-news tape is available for 2024-2025; hosted Qwen is separately tested and is not credited with this price-only P&L.
protocol.limitations: New periods untouched by this strategy selection, but Timestral is a 2026 pretrained model with unknown historical pretraining overlap. Retrospective reconstruction, not a clean vintage out-of-sample claim. Selected surviving instruments, fractional shares, no taxes/FX/cash interest. No promise of 10% returns.

price_manifest.basis: Yahoo split-adjusted OHLC as delivered, separate cash dividends; revisions possible
